install.note: Native curl / PowerShell installs auto-update. Homebrew and WinGet require their package-manager upgrade commands by default. npm is still supported and installs the same native binary through optional dependencies; it requires Node.js 22+ at install time. Keep optional dependencies and the package postinstall enabled. Linux apt / dnf / apk instructions are also available at the official setup docs. Verify installation before starting account setup.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: Claude Code requires direct access to claude.ai — this site is blocked in mainland China. Installation success rate is nearly zero without a VPN/proxy. There are NO mirror alternatives for Claude Code.
blocked_regions.zh-TW: Claude Code requires access to claude.ai. If your network cannot reach it, you may need a proxy.

first_run.description: Confirm installation with `claude --version` and `claude doctor`. For first-time authentication, launch `claude` in the user’s terminal and follow the account or configured-provider flow.

settings_json.description: Current permission rules use permissions.allow / permissions.ask / permissions.deny. The old top-level allowedTools field is not the settings schema. Installation alone does not require granting tools or rewriting onboarding state. Preserve existing settings; configure task-specific permissions only when needed for an authorized task.
